steps.text: Click the row of the member you want to update — here "Member One" — to open their detail page.

steps.text: Click "Modify" in the member header — the update dialog opens, pre-populated with the member's current information.

steps.text: Go on to the next step.

steps.text: Correct the first name if needed.
steps.title: First name

steps.text: Update the first name and email address in the matching fields. The other fields stay as they were and are preserved unchanged.
steps.title: Enter the new information

steps.text: Go on to the next step.
steps.title: Next step

steps.text: Check or correct the member's IBAN.
